title: Battle in 5 Seconds Goes on Hiatus Due to Author's Poor Health
content: Miyakokasiwa previously went on hiatus in October 2024, noting health and personal issues since the start of 2024, and added that the series is approaching its end. The manga resumed serialization in January 2025.

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Confirms a New U.S. Release in 2027 Amid Indefinite Hiatus
content: It’s been several months since the Solo Leveling : Ragnarok manhwa went on an indefinite hiatus. Following the second season’s finale in January this year, the lead artist, Jin, had to be enlisted in mandatory military service.

title: Duel Masters GT Manga's 3rd Part Launches
content: Hiroki Kikuzuma and Daisuke Kawasaki launched the third part of their Duel Masters GT manga on Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic manga website on Wednesday. The new manga is titled Duel Masters GT3 -Glitch of the Twin heart- .

title: Kei Yose's The Villainess Speaks Not Light Novels Get Manga Adaptation

title: Controversial Amazon Anime Finds Its Way To Netflix
content: In 2025, one of the biggest anime to make waves in the anime community was gaining notoriety for all the wrong reasons. Said franchise first got its start in the 1980s with a manga from creator Akimi Yoshida, having an original run that ran for nearly a decade.

title: Pokémon Bank App Ends Service in February 2027
content: The company also revealed that the Nintendo Switch releases of the Pokémon FireRed Version and Pokémon LeafGreen Version games will get Pokémon Home compatibility in October, allowing players to transfer their Pokémon from the games to the storage service.

title: Dae-geon Jung's Novel Rapids Gets Webtoon Adaptation
content: Publisher Minumsa revealed on August 5 that Rapids , a Korean novel by Dae-geon Jung, is set to expand into other forms of media, with a webtoon adaptation and a screen adaptation now confirmed.

title: 22 Years Ago, A Cartoon Network Classic Debut (And Fans Are Awaiting Its Spin-Off)
content: Cartoon Network has spent decades creating the most original animated series the world has ever seen. With the likes of The Powerpuff Girls, Ed, Edd, ‘n Eddy, Dexter’s Laboratory , and too many others to count, the channel is still producing wild new series to this day.

title: Com2uS Pushes Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Game to 2028
content: Com2uS, a Korean gaming company, has delayed its Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint game to 2028, a year later than the 2027 window the company had previously pointed to in May, according to its second-quarter 2026 earnings presentation released on August 12.
